description: Include a spectral sample exactly on the lower 90% occupied-power boundary.

oracle.description: The lower occupied limit is exactly 0.125 Hz in binary64 and the upper limit is approximately 0.619792 Hz. Inclusive comparison retains the flat 0.125 through 0.5 Hz samples; no peak is detected and the first maximum selects 0.125 Hz. Excluding the boundary would incorrectly select 0.25 Hz and delay 2 instead of 4.
